sql: BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '5s'; SELECT clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS measured_at_utc, inet_server_addr() AS server_addr, inet_server_port() AS server_port, current_database() AS database_name, count(*) AS metadata_row_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE audio_file_path IS NULL OR audio_file_path = '') AS missing_path_row_count, max(updated_at) AS latest_metadata_updated_at FROM public.fct_minio__call; COMMIT;
